stores.note: The domain given (neighbourshop.com) times out; the store's real site is shopneighbour.com (Shopify). Prices are USD from the /en-us/ storefront (Shopify rate there is about 0.721 USD per CAD). Stock checked per variant on 2026-09-25: the moleskin shirt is only in stock in IV/L.
stores.vibe: A Gastown menswear shop run by an editor: quiet Japanese, British and Canadian labels (Graphpaper, Auralee, Lady White Co, James Coward, Margaret Howell, Tender) chosen for fabric first, with a lot of moleskin, corduroy, selvedge and hairy wool.
